summary: daemon.js: added sweepStaleLoops() (mirrors sweepStaleClaims pattern) — demotes active=false on ANY of: iteration cap exceeded, token budget exhausted, driving session dead, or no progress (lastProgress/startedAt) past loop_stale_minutes threshold (default STALE_PROGRESS_MIN_DEFAULT=30). Added sessionIsLive(session) helper (running agent in session OR recently-touched in_progress claim owned by a same-session agent ⇒ live; empty session ⇒ live). Wired sweep into decideAll() (runs first each heartbeat) AND a 60s unref'd setInterval at startup so un-driven zombies (e.g. session 0b0c92cd) are reclaimed without a poll. Records L.sweptReason for visibility.
